Target interpretation: Summary and ID gates are reported exactly as measured by the existing variants_report.py readers. Below-target rows remain visible. Source contradictions, reused or non-finding section namespaces, clean reports, and incomplete text cannot be repaired by changing labels, inventing findings, deleting denominator documents, or opening holdouts. Status coverage is availability, not an independent accuracy estimate; no claim of improved held-out accuracy is made. No shared framework source was changed.
